meanings: 【名詞】口、唇（the opening in your face for eating or speaking）
【名詞】河口、川が海に注ぐ場所（the opening of a river where it flows into the sea）
【動詞】(言葉を) 無言で唇で示す、口に出す（to form words silently with your lips）
【動詞】～のように話す、語る（to speak words, especially insincerely）
